text:
According to our policy, **Plant Club charges your card on the 25th of the previous month**.

So if you're subscribed to Plant Club (either Starter at $29/month or Collector at $49/month), you'll see the charge on the **25th**, and your box will ship in the first full week of the following month.

If you need to make changes to your Plant Club subscription (skip, pause, change plan, or cancel), you can do that from **Account > Subscriptions**. Just note that changes made before the 25th affect the next box, while changes on or after the 25th apply to the following month's box.

Is there anything else about your Plant Club subscription I can help with?
